titel: From Page to Screen: Inside "Lucky" Live with Author Marissa Stapley

einzeiler: Marissa Stapley discusses her thriller Lucky, its audiobook, and the Apple TV adaptation.
kurzfassung: Author Marissa Stapley joins a live podcast recording in New York City to discuss her hit thriller Lucky. She shares how an unclaimed lottery radio report and a bus ride inspired the story of a con woman. The conversation also explores the book's adaptation into an Apple TV series produced by Hello Sunshine and its audiobook edition.
stichpunkte: Marissa Stapley developed the concept for Lucky after hearing a radio report about an unclaimed lottery ticket and a potential fugitive claiming it.
The author describes how she suddenly envisioned the main character while riding a bus and immediately texted her agent.
Stapley wanted to center a con artist story around a female protagonist, drawing inspiration from heist films like Ocean's Eleven.
To make readers empathize with a criminal, Stapley added a childhood prologue to show the character's early background.
Researching grifts involved borrowing books from the Toronto Public Library and watching online videos about counting cards and short-changing.
Lucky has been adapted into an Apple TV series produced by Hello Sunshine, starring actors like Anya Taylor-Joy and Annette Bening.
Stapley reflects on how her single mother taught her resilience, a trait reflected in her writing philosophy and career.

clips.hook: A radio report about an unclaimed lottery ticket sparked a thriller idea.
clips.text: While listening to a broadcast about an expiring multi-million dollar prize during a family ski trip, the author began gathering inspiration for a new story.

clips.hook: A real-life romance con involving someone posing as Bruno Mars.
clips.text: Online news items about sophisticated scams highlighted instances where victims surrendered large sums of money after being manipulated by online personas.

clips.hook: A specific airplane superstition and a handmade friendship bracelet.
clips.text: Personal rituals include physically tapping the exterior of an aircraft before every flight and wearing a sentimental accessory until it naturally disintegrates.

clips.hook: Screaming at the TV screen when a producer credit finally appeared.
clips.text: Spotting her own name displayed in the credits during a private viewing session caused an overwhelmingly loud reaction from everyone in the room.

clips.hook: A strong literary recommendation for a celebrity memoir audiobook.
clips.text: Listening to Viola Davis recount her life story in an audio format stands out as a premier recommendation.

beschreibung:
This week, we’re bringing you inside our recent live recording in NYC, hosted by Apple Books and Reese’s Book Club.
Fresh off a city Story Walk listening to Lucky on Apple Books, host Danielle sits down with bestselling author Marissa Stapley for a conversation about her beloved Reese’s Book Club thriller and its journey to the screen as a limited series on Apple TV, adapted with Hello Sunshine. They dive into the inspiration behind the riveting con woman at the center, why high-stakes heist stories never fail to hook us, and what it takes to write a morally gray antihero you can't help but root for. Plus, Marissa reveals who she'd cast to narrate her memoir (hint: she has over 20 Oscar nominations!).
Put your headphones on, take yourself on your own Story Walk, and tune in.
